title: Evens, Doubled
goal: Keep the even numbers, double them. Order the pipeline.
hints: A slice has no .filter — something has to turn it into an iterator first.
Doubling before filtering also compiles… but doubles change which numbers are even. Check what the test expects.
explanation: Two orders compile: filter-then-map and map-then-filter. Only the tests tell them apart — after doubling, every number is even, so map-then-filter returns all four values instead of two. This is the core iterator instinct: the pipeline is evaluated lazily element by element, in exactly the order you compose, and .collect() must come last because it is what finally drives the iteration.
